source_reference: Inspired by ethereum/execution-spec-tests coverage of TSTORE/TLOAD gas-exhaustion paths (test_run_until_out_of_gas), not a verbatim copy
description: A contract performs a sequence of TSTORE operations across multiple slots, then runs out of gas partway through a subsequent call. Verifies the extractor only reflects transient writes that were actually committed to the frame before the OOG halt, and that no partial/uncommitted writes leak into the SSR.
